column5: Imagine you find a strange machine in your room.
And suddenly, there are two of you.
Your clone cleans your room, while you play games all day.
It even goes to school for you.
And it gets better grades than you ever did.
But one night, the clone comes home…
and it doesn't go back in the machine.
The next morning, your mom calls your name…
and she walks right past you.
Because now, the clone is you.
